title: Personal Loans Servicing Standard: Payoff and Closing a Loan
content:
## Standard

A Personal Loans loan closes as paid off when a posted payment brings unpaid principal, accrued interest through the payment's effective date and unpaid fees to zero - either a payoff payment at least equal to the payoff amount of a quote good through the effective date, the final scheduled installment, or a refinance payoff transfer. The closure reason is refinanced for a refinance payoff transfer, paid after charge-off when the loan was charged off, paid as scheduled when the closing payment is the installment due on the maturity date, and early payoff otherwise. A payoff payment smaller than the amount needed is applied as an ordinary payment and the loan stays active. Any overpayment is refunded to the source account within the grade's overpayment refund business days and is not left on the loan. On payoff, AutoPay ends (reason loan closed) and any Payment Protection plan on the loan terminates. If the closing payment is later returned, the returned-payment terms reinstate the loan.

## Closure reason

| Closing payment | Closure reason |
|---|---|
| refinance payoff transfer from a Larkspur refinance loan | refinanced |
| any payment that clears a charged-off loan | paid after charge-off |
| the installment due on the maturity date | paid as scheduled |
| any other closing payment | early payoff |

## Cases (hypothetical figures)

- A quote good through 21 March states 8041.64 USD; a payoff payment of 8050.00 USD effective 21 March closes the loan as early payoff, and the 8.36 USD overpayment is refunded to the source account.
- A payoff payment of 8000.00 USD against that quote is smaller than needed: it is applied as an ordinary payment and the loan stays active.
